comment: Userland overlay: files shown read-only over sealed system directories without touching the system volume.
//boot:package reads this list (tools/package/overlay.py): it stages each built file in its overlay/<path>,
adds the CDHash of every 'trust' file to the static trust cache (own module, launch-constraint category 0)
and lists each file's directory, with its optional 'boot-arg' gate, in ADT /chosen switch-overlay.
The deploy script copies the staged tree to /private/var/Switch/overlay/ on the Data volume. At boot, after
the Data mount and before launchd, the kernel (SwitchRawMount.h native_switch_raw_overlay) union-binds
/private/var/Switch/overlay<directory> over <directory> for every listed directory, unless its gate is set.
Fields: path (absolute), source (relative to tree/), trust (signed Mach-O), mode (octal, default 0755 for
trusted code, 0644 otherwise), boot-arg (the switch-no-<feature> that hides the directory; all files of one
directory share it; 'a|b' hides it only when both are set, for directories features share).
union (optional): the directory to union instead of the file's own, an existing ancestor of path.
The audio HAL union (our plug-in) is hidden by switch-no-audio, like audiomxd itself.
ProgressUI's boot logo (backboardd's Apple logo overlay) is boot/logo's, the same pixels hekate's bootlogo.bmp puts
on the panel, under each name ProgressUI looks for at a truncated main-screen-scale of 1 or 2 (iPadOS 17 and 27).
portrait (optional): staged only for a portrait-native kernel (drivers/NativeMobileDisplay/SwitchPortrait.h).
debug (optional): staged only in debug boot packages (switch-fetchform, which the BlueTool stand-in runs on request;
switch-texpeer, HW Test's second process for shared textures, which 21H461's stand-in and 24B119's launchd start).
kind (optional): staged only for that IPSW kind (--//ipsw:kind), for paths only that kind has or loads.
J120's speaker strips give the presets and bypass flags of VirtualAudio's built-in DSP chain for the speaker port
(nine AUs tuned for J120's four MAX98723 drivers). drivers/SwitchAudio/tunings has same-named ones, gated like the
plug-in, that bypass every AU of those chains except the volume (see hal/SwitchAudioPlugIn.c). iOS 27 (J181) builds
the speaker port's chain from the DSP graphs of its acoustic ID's directory (AID2003/VAD/speaker_*.dspg: loudness
normalizer, virtual bass, two ToneMeisters, vrq2, MeisterStueck, ControlFreak and speaker protection V3, tuned for
J181's MAX98357s), its strips matching boxes by name: tunings/AID2003 bypasses every box but the volume (vrq2;
AUVolume in measurement).
The VideoDecoders union (HEVCH8, AVD) has no gate: AVD registers nothing until the kernel publishes TegraNVDEC.
AVD sits in each kind's empty AVDRegister slot: AVD.videodecoder on 21H461, AVD.videodecoder_ps on 24B119, whose
dyld cache holds Apple's own AVD.videodecoder (drivers/SwitchVideoDecoders/AVD/AVDRegister.c).
H264H7.videoencoder (AVE on NVENC) has no gate either: it registers only once the kernel published TegraNVENC (E3).
The iPadOS 17 and Lake wallpapers of each IPSW's own iPad (WallpaperKit loads a bundle only at the device's logical
screen class, which follows switch-ui-scale, or at 'any'; an IPSW ships @2x only): each bundle directory is its own
union, showing an 'any' Wallpaper.plist (tools/package/wallpaper_1x.py, pinned) over the sealed one, with the sealed
.ca and images beneath. No gate.
SwitchHWTest.app (hw_test_app, debug packages only) is a bundle entry: the whole .app from its .ipa, every Mach-O
in the trust cache, in a union over /Applications. boot/BUILD.bazel gives each kind the app built for its iOS
version; iOS 27 also gets SwitchHWTest27e.app, the same app built arm64e. When they change, the deploy has
switch-appregd register them at the next boot as installd registers a built-in app (tools/deploy/app_journal.py).
switch-appregd and joyconpaird share /usr/libexec, which no boot-arg hides: only the BlueTool stand-in starts them
on iOS 17, and on iOS 27 the kernel disables joyconpaird's launchd job with switch-no-bt.
SwitchShaderCompiler (drivers/TegraGM20BMetal/compiler) compiles every GPU client's states the pack lacks into one
store: launchd starts it on iOS 27, the BlueTool stand-in on iOS 17 (so with switch-no-bt there it does not run, and
the kernel then tells clients no compiler will come).
Debug iOS 27 packages show iOS 27's com.apple.coreanimation logging profile with CADebug's info lines persisted
(drivers/NativeMobileDisplay/logging).
iOS 27's launchd bootstraps /System/Cryptexes/Supplemental/System/Library/LaunchDaemons when the commpage
byte it checks is set, which the 27 kernel does (commpage.c). That path is a symlink to
/private/preboot/Cryptexes/Supplemental, which the 27 kernel creates as this union's point: our daemons' plists go
there, and overlay.py refuses anything else under it but one file: the jetsam properties overlay launchd reads
from there (its SupplementalJetsamProperties). 27's launchd ignores a plist's JetsamProperties: a daemon's band
and limits come from the jetsam properties tables alone, where J181's Daemon Override Global gives 6 MB to any
daemon they do not name.
iOS 27's camera description of J181 (CMCapture.framework/J181/AVCaptureSession.plist, which CMCapture finds by
MobileGestalt's HWModelDescriptionForCamera) lists its cameras and the video effects cameracaptured compiles
shaders for at every launch (FigCapturePreloadShaders). The Switch has none, so its J181 description is empty:
no capture device and no effect. The union cannot hide the sealed file, so it shows the empty one over it.
